messages:
Lena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GTM priorities. Opening a thread to collect action items on PLG pilots, partner SLAs, and pipeline visibility. Please reply with owner + ETA.

Raj: Flagging two asks from leadership: 1) a default mid-market pilot package we can approve fast, 2) a concise definition of "sales-qualified" for self-serve conversions.

Priya: I'll take #2. Thinking we set SQL = paid ARR forecast >= $X + tech use case match (api or dedicated). Will run numbers with Maya. ETA: Tue 10am.

Maya: Sharing cohort summary tomorrow AM. Suggest we use 3-month ARR run rate as signal rather than one-off purchases.

Clara: For pilot SKUs, product needs to know allowed feature set (KV cache, streaming, private endpoints). Propose two SKUs: "Eval-Light" and "Eval-Managed".

Diego: For partner-led deals, leadership asked for a short handoff checklist. I'll draft a 1-page flow: referral -> MQL -> partner qualifies -> handoff to sales/SE. Need Legal on partner terms.

Tess: Can review partner T&Cs quickly, but need to know if revenue recognition or distributor margins apply. Diego, send me the draft by Wed and I'll answer by Fri COB.

Priya: Also leadership wants a roll-up metric for pipeline quality: % of PLG accounts that hit SQL within 60 days. Clara, can product emit an event for “first-paid” and “trial-start” so we can instrument this?

Clara: Yep, we'll add events. ETA for instrumentation on staging: next sprint (start Mon).

Raj: Ops question: do we allow automatic conversion from Eval-Light to subscription? Ops/Legal?

Tess: Auto-convert is fine for <$5k pilot but need clear cancellation terms. For anything larger we'll want a short SOW.

Diego: I'll include recommended partner enablement materials (playbook + demo scripts) in the handoff doc. Also propose a "partner readiness" checkbox list partners must complete before co-sell.

Maya: Customer success can own the "time-to-first-value" metric for pilots. We'll measure days to first successful integration + first API call with production tokens. I'll post a measurement plan Thursday.

Lena: Can someone create a single shared doc that captures all these decisions for exec review? Prefer a 1-pager with owners, ETAs, and blockers.

Priya: I'll make a Google doc and invite the group. Link coming when the SQL rubric draft is ready.

deploy-bot: Heads up: demo infra deploy scheduled tonight 02:00 UTC may reset staging datasets.

Clara: Note on deploy: we should lock demo environments 1 hour before any partner-facing session. I'll add a checklist for demo ops.

Raj: OK. Owners: Priya (SQL rubric) Tue 10am, Diego (partner handoff doc) Wed EOD, Clara (event instrumentation) sprint start, Maya (TFV plan) Thu COB, Tess (legal check on pilots) Fri COB. If anyone needs to reassign ping here.

Diego: Small ask 4DD  I'll add partner examples (referral vs co-sell) so sales has concrete playbooks. ETA Wed 3pm.

Lena: Thanks team 44D I'll pull into an exec summary after drafts are in.

Priya: Doc link: https://docs.google.com/example (draft)
